sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: This app collects the following information: Name, Email, Phone Number, and a message. This information is used to contact you to discuss the project. It is not used for any other purpose.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
sections.body: Contact information you provide (name, email, phone number, and message) is used solely to respond to your inquiry. It is not sold, rented, or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: XO Fun uses Google AdMob to display advertisements. AdMob may collect device identifiers and usage data to serve ads. Child-directed treatment is enabled under COPPA, which instructs Google to serve only non-personalized ads. For details, see Google's privacy policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: Contact information submitted through the app is retained only as long as necessary to respond to your inquiry and is then deleted.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: XO Fun is designed for general audiences including children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. The app is configured to comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). For information on how Google handles data in child-directed contexts, please review Google's privacy policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We do not collect any personal information. The App does not require you to create an account, sign in, or provide any personal details to play.

sections.heading: Data Stored on Your Device
sections.body: The App keeps track of your game statistics (such as wins, losses, and games played) so you can see your progress over time. This information is stored locally on your device using Apple's standard local storage (UserDefaults) and never leaves your device. It is not synced to iCloud, sent to any server, or shared with any third party. You can clear this data at any time by resetting your statistics within the App or by deleting the App from your device.

sections.heading: Advertising
sections.body: The App uses Google AdMob to display banner advertisements. Ads are requested as non-personalized only — the App does not show the App Tracking Transparency permission prompt and does not allow AdMob to track you across other companies' apps or websites. To serve ads, measure their performance, and protect against fraud, Google's Mobile Ads SDK may collect: a device identifier (used for ads, frequency capping, and fraud prevention); approximate (coarse) location, estimated from IP address; advertising interaction data (such as ads shown or clicked); and crash and performance diagnostics. This data is not linked to your identity and is not used to track you across other apps or websites. It is handled according to Google's Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy) and How Google uses information from partner sites or apps (https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites).

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: The App integrates with Google AdMob to display advertising, as described above. It does not integrate with any other third-party services, analytics providers, or advertising networks.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: The App does not knowingly collect any personal information from anyone, including children under the age of 13. Advertising shown in the App is limited to non-personalized ads.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: If this Privacy Policy is updated, the revised version will be posted at this same location with an updated effective date.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at itsnateguy@gmail.com.

sections.heading: The Short Version
sections.body: Daily Weave has no backend server. We do not collect, see, store, or have access to any of your habit data, personal information, or usage activity. Everything you enter into the App stays on your device and, if you choose to enable sync, in your own personal iCloud account — never on servers we operate or control.

sections.heading: Information We Do Not Collect
sections.body: We do not collect: your name, email address, or any account information (the App has no sign-up or login of its own — it relies entirely on your device's existing Apple ID); analytics, usage tracking, or behavioral data; advertising identifiers (and we do not show ads); or payment and billing information (see "Purchases and Subscriptions" below). The App contains no analytics SDKs, advertising SDKs, or third-party tracking libraries of any kind.

sections.heading: Your Habit Data
sections.body: Habits, schedules, and completion history you create in the App are stored locally on your device, always. If you're a Pro subscriber and have iCloud enabled on your device, they are also stored in your own private iCloud account. This uses Apple's CloudKit framework, which stores data in a private database tied to your personal Apple ID. We have no access to this data — it is stored and managed by Apple under your own iCloud account, the same way your Photos or Notes sync across your devices. If you use the Apple Watch companion app, the same data syncs to your Watch through this same private iCloud mechanism.

sections.heading: Notifications
sections.body: Habit reminders are scheduled entirely through your device's local notification system. No reminder content or scheduling data is sent to us or any third party.

sections.heading: Photos
sections.body: If you export your Stats "tapestry" as an image, the App requests permission to add that image to your Photo Library. The App cannot read, browse, or access your existing photos — this permission only allows saving the exported image.

sections.heading: Purchases and Subscriptions
sections.body: Daily Weave offers optional Pro purchases (a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase) processed entirely through Apple's App Store. We do not collect or see your payment method, billing address, or any other payment details — this is handled exclusively by Apple in accordance with Apple's own privacy policy.

sections.heading: Data Retention and Deletion
sections.body: Since your data lives locally on your device and in your own iCloud account rather than on any server we control, you are always in full control of it. Deleting a habit in the App deletes it from your device and, if sync is enabled, from your private iCloud database. Uninstalling the App removes all local data, and if sync is enabled you can also delete the data from your iCloud storage via your device's Settings. We have no copy of your data to retain or delete on our end, because we never had one.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: Daily Weave is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, regardless of age — since we do not collect personal information from any user in the first place.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: The only third party involved in the App's operation is Apple Inc., through standard platform services (iCloud/CloudKit for sync, StoreKit for purchases, and push/local notification frameworks). We do not share, sell, or transmit any data to anyone — because we do not collect any to begin with.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: If this policy changes, we will update the effective date above and post the revised policy at this same location. Continued use of the App after a change constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact Nathan Guy at itsnateguy@gmail.com.
